requirement: One release-note block for the whole product with one label: a desktop: PR line is Desktop only, shown as a badge on the changelog page; the shipped notes carry no label

oracle.invariant: S1: lines of a release-note block and of an old desktop-release-note block in the same PR are both read, NONE dropped; 'Desktop:   x' and '- DESKTOP:x' become 'desktop: x' and '- desktop: x'; 'web: …' is rejected while 'Mac: now needs macOS 13 or later.' is kept; the PR template ships ```release-note with NONE, mentions desktop:, and no longer ships the old block. S2: a 'desktop:' PR line drafts as '- <text> _(Desktop only)_' in Highlights, Changes and a patch section, an unlabelled line as a plain bullet; releaseNotesFromPage drops the badge and returns plain '- <text>' (no 'desktop:', no 'Desktop only'); docsServeNotes matches the sha256 of the plain notes and not of the badged text; a page bullet with 'desktop:', 'web:', 'mobile:', '_(Web only)_' or a badge that is not at the end of the bullet is a problem. S3: every committed page passes; 0.5.md has at least one Desktop only line and its Highlights ship as plain text with no 'desktop:' and no 'Desktop only'; a copy with '- web: …' or '_(Web only)_' fails; the index says every change people see, on the web and in the desktop app, Desktop only marked.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
